waybackify cache crawl [flags] [wayback-url] [wayback-url...]

Crawl documents to a dynamic-completeness fixpoint

Drive the `remaster verify` DYNAMIC probe to a fixpoint over documents in
a cache root: render each through a strict server with non-local origins
abort-routed, record the browser-discovered dynamic[] requisites it still
reaches for, fetch them, and re-render — until a render makes zero
unexpected web.archive.org requests (or --max-iterations is hit). The
completeness pass behind the standalone tier.

Pass replay URLs as trailing positionals (give FLAGS FIRST; a flag after
a URL is rejected, never swallowed) and/or --ledger <dir> to crawl every
HTML document under it. Needs agent-browser only when there is uncached
work to probe (the verified fast-path is free); --static-only skips the
browser entirely (LOUD: completeness is NOT verified).

Output: a JSON run summary on stdout, progress on stderr. Exit 0 = every
doc verified (or nothing to do), 1 = any flaky/unconverged/errored.

Arguments:
  [wayback-url]            optional. a web.archive.org/web/<ts>/<orig> replay URL to crawl (repeatable — put all flags first)
  [wayback-url...]         additional replay URLs (every trailing positional)

Flags:
  --root|-r <root>         cache root to crawl (already holds the docs) — required
  --output|-o <root>       deprecated alias of --root|-r
  --ledger <dir>           corpus batch: also crawl every HTML document under <dir>
  --max-iterations <n>     reference-depth cap per doc (default 4)
  --force                  re-probe docs already stamped verified
  --static-only            skip the browser probe; close ALREADY-recorded dynamic[] only (LOUD: completeness NOT verified)
  --allow-escapes <file>   allowed-escapes policy override (default: the committed policy)
  --max <n>                archive.org request cap for this run (default: unlimited)
  --delay-ms <n>           pacing between captures (default 1500)
  --har                    write per-doc request logs to <root>/.crawl/har/
  --browser-cmd <cmd>      the agent-browser executable (default: agent-browser)
  --help|-h                Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
